assertions.assertion: The patient presents with paroxysmal palpitations and episodic lightheadedness
raising concern for recurrent supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to assess arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation therapy
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is the diagnostic procedure at issue
harborview's denial under PR-204 states that this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
